entities.name: Islamic Golden Age Sciences
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The scientific achievements of the Islamic Golden Age (c. 800–1300 CE), including the invention of algebra, advances in optics, astronomy, and medicine. Islamic scholars preserved and extended Greek, Indian, and Persian knowledge, transmitting it to medieval Europe.
